items.question: What size should I get?
items.answer: Our fit is true-to-size. We recommend checking the detailed size chart on each product page. If you train heavy and prefer a looser fit, size up. Compression fit is our default cut — built to hug your muscles without restricting movement.

items.question: How do I care for FlexKnit Pro?
items.answer: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. The zinc fiber anti-odor treatment is permanent — it's woven into the fiber structure and doesn't wash out. Avoid fabric softener as it can reduce moisture-wicking performance.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: Yes! We ship to 45+ countries. Free express shipping within India on orders Rs. 1499+. International shipping calculated at checkout with tracking included.

items.answer: 30-day returns, no questions asked. Items must be unworn with tags attached. We provide free return shipping labels. Refunds processed within 3-5 business days.
